name: Inflame Appliances Limited
about: Inflame Appliances Limited manufactures and sells kitchen appliances in India. The company offers liquefied petroleum gas stoves, cooktops, chimney, and sheet metal components. It also provides pyramid, curved glass, straight t-shaped, vertical, and island chimneys, as well as built-in gas hobs. The company offers its products under the Inflame brand name. The company was formerly known as Techno Engineering Corporation and changed its name to Inflame Appliances Limited in November 2017. Inflame Appliances Limited was founded in 2010 and is based in Panchkula, India.
